tasks.subject: Task 3: Android native project + FCM push credentials
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Buildable android/ project with adaptive icon, splash screen, and Google services config; Expo push service holds FCM V1 credentials so Android devices receive notifications.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app.json` (android block + expo-splash-screen plugin), `package.json`
- Create: `google-services.json` (repo root; committed), `assets/icon-adaptive-foreground.png` (committed); `android/` is generated by prebuild/CNG and gitignored (`/android/` in .gitignore) - never committed, local Gradle build is verification-only

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- app.json android block has adaptiveIcon (foreground ./assets/icon-adaptive-foreground.png, background #FDFCF5) and googleServicesFile [DONE]
- expo-splash-screen plugin configured with image + background #FDFCF5 [DONE]
- `npx expo prebuild --platform android` completes without error [DONE]
- `cd android && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL [DONE, verified 2026-08-06 after installing Android SDK cmdline-tools + JDK 17 via brew - see below]
- eas credentials shows a Google Service Account key for FCM V1 [OUTSTANDING - needs user-provided service-account key]

**Verify:** `cd android && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL

**Steps:** BLOCK on user providing google-services.json (Firebase project with Android app com.thebizofhappiness.app) and a service-account JSON key (kept private, never committed); `npx expo install expo-splash-screen`; update app.json android block + splash plugin per plan doc; `npx expo prebuild --platform android` (NEVER prebuild ios); gradle assembleDebug; user runs `! npx eas-cli credentials --platform android` to upload the FCM V1 service-account key; commit app.json/assets/google-services.json/package.json (NOT android/, gitignored).

**2026-08-06 execution notes:**
- No Android SDK was installed on this machine; installed via `brew install --cask android-commandlinetools` + accepted licenses + installed platform-tools, platforms;android-36, build-tools;36.0.0, ndk;27.1.12297006.
- Gradle 9.3.1 (from the generated wrapper) + the pinned `foojay-resolver-convention:0.5.0` inside `@react-native/gradle-plugin`'s included build are incompatible (`NoSuchFieldError: JvmVendorSpec.IBM_SEMERU`, removed in newer Gradle). The plugin's build requires JDK 17 (`kotlin { jvmToolchain(17) }`); only JDK 22/11 were present, triggering foojay auto-download, which then hit the incompatibility. Fixed by `brew install openjdk@17` and passing `-Porg.gradle.java.installations.paths=<jdk17 home> -Porg.gradle.java.installations.auto-download=false` to the gradlew invocation so it finds JDK 17 locally instead of downloading via foojay.
- The original `assets/icon.png` (copied from ios/ in Task 2) was discovered to be a pure white 1024x1024 image with zero content - not a corruption, the source iOS asset itself was blank. User supplied a real icon (~/Downloads/ICON.png, "BIZ of Happy" wordmark on pink-cream gradient) which replaced it. The full-bleed version clips under Android's adaptive-icon safe-zone mask (confirmed by simulating a 66% center crop), so a separate `assets/icon-adaptive-foreground.png` was generated (artwork scaled to 60%, centered on a transparent 1024x1024 canvas) and used only for `android.adaptiveIcon.foregroundImage`; iOS icon, Android legacy square icon, and splash screen all use the untouched full-bleed `assets/icon.png`.
- Confirmed via merged manifest (`android/app/build/intermediates/merged_manifest/debug/expoDebugOverrideMaxSdkConflicts/AndroidManifest.xml`) that all four blockedPermissions from Task 2 are absent, closing that task's forward note.
- Committed in 394f41b: app.json, assets/icon.png, assets/icon-adaptive-foreground.png, package.json, package-lock.json, google-services.json. android/ correctly left untracked per .gitignore.
- User ran `eas-cli credentials --platform android` interactively in a separate terminal (the harness's non-interactive bash can't drive its TTY menu) to upload the FCM V1 service-account key to Expo's push service. Not independently re-verified via CLI (no clean non-interactive listing command); real confirmation deferred to Task 9's on-device Android push test.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app.json", "package.json", "google-services.json", "assets/icon.png", "assets/icon-adaptive-foreground.png"], "verifyCommand": "cd android && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug", "acceptanceCriteria": ["prebuild android succeeds", "gradle assembleDebug succeeds", "FCM V1 service account key uploaded to Expo"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Deploy boh-admin to static hosting
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Admin portal live on a public HTTPS domain with Supabase env configured.

**Files:**
- Create: `boh-admin/vercel.json`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `cd boh-admin && npm run build` succeeds locally
- Deployed URL loads the login screen over HTTPS
- SPA routes deep-link correctly (no 404 on refresh) via rewrite rule

**Verify:** `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://<deployed-domain>/` -> 200

**Steps:** Create boh-admin/vercel.json with the SPA rewrite ({"rewrites": [{"source": "/(.*)", "destination": "/index.html"}]}); verify local build; user runs `! cd boh-admin && npx vercel login && npx vercel --prod` (Vercel is the chosen default host - say so and let the user object); user sets VITE_SUPABASE_URL + VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in Vercel project env (same values as boh-admin/.env) and redeploys; curl-check the domain; commit vercel.json; record the deployed domain for Task 7.

**2026-08-07 execution notes:**
- First `vercel --prod` (run from boh-admin/) failed the cloud build: `Cannot find module '../src/theme/palette.json'` - tailwind.config.cjs intentionally reaches one directory above boh-admin/ for the palette shared with the mobile app (CLAUDE.md: colors must be centrally sourced). Vercel's project Root Directory was scoped to boh-admin/, so the cloud build never had that file.
- Fixed by rooting the deploy at the monorepo root instead: moved the SPA rewrite from boh-admin/vercel.json into a new root vercel.json with `framework: null` and installCommand/buildCommand/outputDirectory scoped into boh-admin/ (commit 1705a75). Also pinned `@testing-library/dom` as an explicit devDependency - it was only present via npm's peer-dependency auto-install, which Vercel's build image (different npm bundled with its Node 24.x) didn't apply, breaking `tsc -b` on boh-admin's own test suite. Verified the whole fix locally via `vercel build` (exact cloud replica) before redeploying.
- Second `vercel --prod` (from repo root) failed at the upload step: `files should NOT have more than 15000 items, received 21600` - repo root has ~186k files on disk (108k in .claude/ worktrees, both node_modules trees, ios/, android/) and the CLI's own file-list step didn't fully honor .gitignore once the deploy root moved. Fixed with an explicit root .vercelignore mirroring .gitignore (commit d5e3702).
- Third `vercel --prod` succeeded (Ready/Production), but curling the per-deployment hash URL returned 302 to vercel.com/sso-api - that's Vercel's own Deployment Protection SSO wall on the auto-generated per-deployment URL, not an app bug. The stable aliased domain https://boh-admin.vercel.app bypasses it and returns 200 with the real login page.
- Caught before fully closing the task: VITE_SUPABASE_URL/VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY were never set in Vercel (confirmed via `vercel env ls production` -> none found), and boh-admin/src/lib/supabase.ts throws at module-evaluation time if either is missing, with no root ErrorBoundary - meaning the live site was serving HTTP 200 but rendering a blank crashed page in-browser. Set both vars for production and preview via `vercel env add` (same anon key already used in eas.json - public by design, RLS enforces security) and redeployed. Confirmed fixed by grepping the rebuilt bundle for the Supabase project ref (present) with `x-vercel-cache: MISS`/`age: 0` (genuinely fresh build, not a stale cache).
- Final verify: https://boh-admin.vercel.app/ -> 200, deep link https://boh-admin.vercel.app/announcements -> 200 (SPA rewrite confirmed working on the real domain).
- Deployed admin domain for Task 7: **https://boh-admin.vercel.app**

```json:metadata
{"files": ["vercel.json", ".vercelignore", "boh-admin/package.json"], "verifyCommand": "curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://boh-admin.vercel.app/", "acceptanceCriteria": ["local production build passes", "deployed URL returns 200 and renders login", "SPA rewrite works"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
